package game.actions
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description

  • Class
    Description
    BreakAction
    An Action that allows an Actor to break a Breakable, provided they are carrying a BreakingTool.
    BuyAction
    An Action that allows an Actor to buy a Purchasable product from a Merchant, provided they have enough coins.
    CapabilityToolAction<C,T extends HasStaminaCost>
    Abstract base class for an Action that requires an Actor to be carrying a specific kind of tool and to use it on a Ground that exposes a matching capability, at a stamina cost determined by the tool by default (see CapabilityToolAction.staminaCost(HasStaminaCost, Object)).
    Consumable
    Capability interface for Items that can be consumed by an Actor.
    ConsumeAction
    An Action that allows an Actor to consume a portable Item that implements Consumable.
    CreatureStateAction
    An Action that advances a StatefulCreature's state machine by one turn: if the current state's conditions call for a different state, switches to it and applies its entry effect; otherwise performs the current state's ordinary behaviour.
    Feedable
    Capability interface for Actors (animals) that can be fed by the Farmer.
    FeedAction
    An Action that allows the Farmer to feed an adjacent animal using a specific food Item.
    Food
    Capability interface for Items that can be used as food to feed an animal.
    Harvestable
    Capability interface for Ground that can be harvested by an Actor, either while standing on it or from an adjacent tile.
    HarvestAction
    An Action that allows an Actor to harvest a crop, either while standing on it or from an adjacent tile, provided the crop is ready (Harvestable.canHarvest()) and the Actor has enough stamina.
    MerchantContext
    The merchant side of a trade: the Actor acting as the merchant, and the merchant's current Location.
    ProcessAction
    An Action that allows the Farmer to process a Processable Item they are carrying using an adjacent ProcessingFacility, replacing it with one new processed layer.
    Purchasable
    Interface representing an item or crop that can be purchased from a seller (e.g., Merchant).
    Sellable
    Interface representing an item in an actor's inventory that can be sold to a buyer (e.g., Merchant).
    SellAction
    An Action that allows an Actor to sell a Sellable Item to a Merchant.
    TillAction
    An Action that allows an Actor to till the Ground at their current Location, provided they are carrying a Hoe and have enough stamina.
    TravelAction
    An Action that moves an Actor to a named destination using a TravelMethod.
    TravelMethod
    A way of travelling to a destination: a ladder, a teleportation circle, an alien device, or any mechanism added later.
    WaterAction
    An Action that lets an Actor water the Ground at a Location with a watering tool.
